entryPoints.invariant: A primary session may not arm supervision or run a guarded tool without the pre-tool checkpoint.
A backlog close marker is replayed only when its recorded identity, data directory, and task id still agree.
entryPoints.note: Called from the staging and replay owners inside its own library; bin/fm-teardown.sh is the executable that reaches both.

entryPoints.invariant: An investigation or review may not complete while a captain call it raised is still open.
A primary session may not leave its declared working directory through an unchecked shell command.
The watcher executes a custom state check only against the exact bytes an intentional registration bound.
A retired custom state check loses its content binding through the owner path, never a hand-composed remove.
entryPoints.reason: No script calls it: bin/fm-teardown.sh removes a spawned task's check artifacts on its own path, so this is the retirement command firstmate runs for a check it registered by hand.

entryPoints.invariant: A no-mistakes ship task's PR head carries the obligated commit identity and no contaminated commit.
A cursor launcher alias is accepted only with evidence that the executable really is cursor-agent.
entryPoints.note: The resolver that every cursor spawn traverses calls it before accepting a candidate.

entryPoints.invariant: Every maintained prose surface is classified exactly once and its local links resolve.
Every enforce-style entry point in bin/ names an enforcing call site rather than shipping inert.
A no-mistakes gate agent may not drive fleet lifecycle commands.
A fleet mutation runs only from a session that holds the verified per-home lock and an untangled checkout.
Only the actor holding a task's supervision lease may change that task.
A supervision lease taken for a guarded change is released on every exit path.
Tracked GitHub workflows lint clean against the pinned actionlint.
The tracked shell surface lints clean against one pinned ShellCheck, identically in CI and the pre-push gate.
The required no-mistakes status workflow acts only on validated input.
Every tracked outbound write records its exact payload bytes, digest, and provider verdict in the ledger.
entryPoints.note: Known-good reference: the shared enforcement owner landed by PR 47 (merge 0a519ea).

entryPoints.invariant: A task's recorded PR identity is validated before a merge poll is armed for it.
A remote job runs only with complete, well-formed transport settings.
entryPoints.note: Called by the job entry path inside its own library, which bin/fm-on.sh and the remote handoff owners traverse.

entryPoints.invariant: Curated durable memory is injected at session start only while the home is within its startup-memory budget.
entryPoints.note: Known-good reference: the gate wired to its startup consumer by PR 46 (merge 0e826aa).

entryPoints.invariant: A subagent may not reach the primary's guarded tool surface unchecked.
The complete-regression lane partition stays proven and every portable serial shard stays inside its job-cap budget.
A launcher or observation shell resolves the qualified tool profile before work depends on it.
A primary turn may not end blind while fleet work is under way.
The same turn-end guard reaches a Cursor primary through its own stop-hook owner.
The same turn-end guard reaches a Grok primary through its registered hook.
A pre-collapse decision identity still verifies against the surviving captain-hold owner.
entryPoints.reason: One-release compatibility shim for briefs written before the decision collapse; the surviving owner bin/fm-captain-hold.sh:verify carries the production call site, and this surface is invoked only by an in-flight brief.

entryPoints.invariant: The secondmate registry stays parseable, with absolute, unique, non-overlapping homes.
entryPoints.reason: A standalone re-check surface for an operator; the same validate_registry predicate already runs inside the transactional seed path, so the invariant is enforced at the write boundary rather than here.

entryPoints.invariant: Activation staging is refused when an isolation input is missing.
entryPoints.reason: An opt-in strictness flag on a captain-authorized launcher cutover procedure that no script schedules; the procedure itself is the invoker.

entryPoints.invariant: Watched tooling with an available or inert update is reported to the supervisor.
entryPoints.reason: A reporter, not an enforcement point: it prints a wake line and refuses nothing. Discovered only because its name carries the word check.
